content: When a customer demands proof of performance, immediately offer a live in-store demonstration of their exact use case (e.g., 'Let's open 20 tabs and your Excel file right now').
Use a risk-reversal guarantee (e.g., 30-day return, no restocking fee) to overcome skepticism, especially for high-involvement tech purchases.
Avoid dismissing the customer's objection by suggesting a workaround (e.g., 'keep your MacBook for heavy tasks') — it undermines the product's value proposition.
Once the customer agrees to a trial, move to closing (e.g., 'Let me print the guarantee and you can take it home today') instead of repeating the same guarantee.
In a retail setting, always have a demo unit ready to run customer-specific tests — this builds trust faster than any spec sheet.

name: Live Stress Test Challenge
condition: When a customer questions product performance under heavy load, especially for power users.
example: Customer: 'Can it handle 20 tabs and Excel?' Salesperson: 'Let's test it right now. I'll open 20 tabs and a large Excel file. If it stutters, you walk. If it holds, you take the trial. Deal?'

name: Written Guarantee Close
condition: When a customer needs risk elimination before committing, especially after a successful demo.
example: Customer: 'I'll take the trial but I want it in writing.' Salesperson: 'Absolutely. I'm printing the guarantee now: 30-day return, no restocking fee. Sign here and take it home today.'

name: Challenge-Response Commitment
condition: When a customer sets a condition for purchase (e.g., 'if it passes my test, I'll buy').
example: Customer: 'If it doesn't stutter, I'll take it.' Salesperson: 'Deal. Watch closely — 20 tabs loading now... Still smooth. Here's your trial unit.'

objection: If it can't handle 20 tabs and Excel, it's not replacing my MacBook.
rebuttal_template: I understand you need one device for everything. Let's test it right now — I'll open 20 tabs and a heavy Excel file on this unit. If it stutters, I'll be honest with you. If it doesn't, you'll see it can handle your workflow. Deal?

objection: A store demo isn't my real workflow.
rebuttal_template: You're right, a demo can't replicate your exact files. That's why we offer a 30-day risk-free trial. Take it home, load your real data, and if it doesn't perform, return it for a full refund — no restocking fee. I'll put that in writing right now.

I'll make it hassle-free for you. Here's my card — if you decide to return it, call me and I'll handle the process. You don't even need to come back to the store. But I'm confident after your real test, you'll keep it.
